2609.01437.title: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
2609.01437.paper_summary: As agents move from research prototypes to deployed tools, their capability increasingly depends on model-external execution infrastructure, commonly termed the agent harness. Changing this harness while holding model weights fixed can substantially alter task performance. Current agent evaluations typically report downstream performance under a chosen harness, leaving a model's ability to develop the harness itself comparatively underexplored. We introduce HarnessDev, a benchmark that shifts the unit of evaluation from task outputs to runnable infrastructure. HarnessDev covers two stages. In Creation, the agent starts from a minimal seed and a small number of cases, then builds a complete execution system. In Evolution, it starts from its own created harness and iteratively revises it using downstream execution feedback, with the goal of improving benchmark performance. We then evaluate each constructed harness on capability (task success on held-out benchmarks) and efficiency (execution-token cost). The reported Creation results cover six creator LLMs, four domains, and five downstream benchmarks totaling 2,207 unique downstream instances, with hidden evaluation tasks withheld from development. We find that generated harnesses remain substantially behind mature human-engineered references on code and on search and research, while matching or exceeding the selected references on writing and machine-learning experimentation, with large variation in execution cost. Evolution produces some performance gains, but they are unstable and transfer only partially to held-out tasks. Experiments with a fixed runtime model further show that the gains depend strongly on the model executing the harness, indicating limited transfer across models.
2609.01437.paper_summary_zh: 隨著代理從研究原型轉向部署工具，其能力越來越依賴於模型外部執行基礎設施，通常稱為代理鞍具。在保持模型權重不變的情況下改變這個鞍具可以顯著改變任務表現。目前的代理評估通常報告在選定鞍具下的下游表現，這使得模型開發鞍具的能力相對未受到充分探索。我們引入了HarnessDev，一個基準，將評估單位從任務輸出轉移到可運行的基礎設施。HarnessDev涵蓋兩個階段。在創建階段，代理從一個最小的種子和少量案例開始，然後構建一個完整的執行系統。在演變階段，它從自己創建的鞍具開始，並使用下游執行反饋進行迭代修訂，目標是提高基準表現。然後，我們根據能力（在保留的基準上的任務成功）和效率（執行令牌成本）評估每個構建的鞍具。報告的創建結果涵蓋六個創建者LLM、四個領域和五個下游基準，共計2,207個獨特的下游實例，其中隱藏的評估任務在開發中被保留。我們發現生成的鞍具在代碼以及搜索和研究方面仍然顯著落後於成熟的人類工程參考，而在寫作和機器學習實驗方面則與選定參考相匹配或超越，執行成本變化很大。演變產生了一些性能增益，但這些增益不穩定，並且僅部分轉移到保留的任務。對固定運行時模型的實驗進一步顯示，增益強烈依賴於執行鞍具的模型，表明模型之間的轉移有限。
